title: List systemd timers
description: Show every systemd timer (modern alternative to cron)

parameters.name: options
parameters.label: Options
parameters.description: --all = every timer, including inactive ones; --state=active = active timers only; --no-pager = print without a pager

notes: systemd timers are more flexible than cron. See /etc/systemd/system/ for the definitions.
